lightIdle: Ṅwalani adreseni iṅwe na iṅwe ya webusaiti. Ri khou ṱola mutevhe washu wa zwitshosetso, tshivhumbeo, u tevhedza merka, DNS na phindulo ya zwino. Kha Ima: bvelani, khwaṱhisedzani nga tshikona tsha mulayo tshine no tshi fulufhedza, naho ni tshi ḓivhadza arali ni tshi ṱoḓa.
lightLimited: Zwo kunaho zwi amba uri u ṱola ho itwaho a hu ngo ṋea tsivhudzo khulwane — a si fulufhedziso ya uri saiti yo tsireledzea.
privacyNote: Zwo dzwiaho: a hu vhulungwi tshithu. U ṱola vhukhakhi hu thusa u khwinisa thaidzo dza thekiniki fhedzi — hu sa vhe adreseni, nahone hu sa vhe u andadza phanḓa.
noClaim: A hu na tshumelo yo nangiwaho
privacy: U ṱola uhwo hu sala kha khomphuyutha hei. A hu vhulungwi hisitori ya u bhrawuza.
invalid: Ṅwalani adreseni ya HTTP kana HTTPS yo teaho.
limits: Zwine u ṱola uhwo hu sa zwi ḓivhi
ignoreRiskTitle: Arali ni tshi sa dzhieli nṱha tsivhudzo hei
ignoreRiskBody: Ni nga ṋea phaswede, zwidodombedzwa zwa mbuelo, kana datha iṅwe ya muthu kha ane a langa adreseni hei. Valani thebu phanḓa ha u ṅwala kana u badela tshithu.
nextStepsTitle: Zwine na tea u ita nga murahu — tshipiḓa nga tshipiḓa
nextStepLeave: Bvelani kha siaṱari ḽiḽi zwino — ni songo bvela phanḓa kha adreseni ye na i ṱola.
nextStepNoCredentials: Ni songo ṅwala phaswede, nomboro dza kharata, khoudu dza SMS/imeili, kana datha iṅwe ya muthu kha saiti hei.
nextStepVerifyOfficial: Khwaṱhisedzani nga u ḓiimisela: vulani domain kana app ya mulayo ya tshumelo tshine no tshi fulufhedza (bukemaka, kharata ya bangi, tshiṱolo tsha app tsho ḓivheaho). Ni songo shumisa luṱingo kana imeili dzo sumbedzwaho kha siaṱari ḽine ḽa vha na khwathiso.
nextStepReport: Nga u nanga: vhulungani fhasi ṅwalwa lwa muvhuso wa hayani uri mushumi a ṱole host ya mutevhe wa zwitshosetso wo langiwaho.
nextStepBlock: Nga u nanga: thivhelani host kha kateloso kana app ya teseke ya buusdo uri zwi vhe zwa vhulea u i vula nga khakhi.
nextStepLooksReal: Masiaṱari a u kanda a vhonala a naka nahone a shumisa HTTPS. Vhuvha ha u vhona a vhu khwaṱhisedzi uri saiti yo teaho.
honestLimitsTitle: Mielano ya vhulondololi ya tshishumiswa itshi
honestLimitNoWipe: buusdo a i koni u fhela mafhungo a muthu ane webusaiti yo no a kuvhanganya. Shandulani phaswede kha saiti ya vhukuma ya mulayo arali no ṅwala tshithu, nahone ni sedze tsivhudzo dza bangi/imeili.
honestLimitNoCrowd: Mvelelo dzi bva kha mutevhe wo langiwaho na zwiga zwa adreseni zwa buusdo — hu si tshiṱhalo tsha lushaka tsha uri ndi vhathu vhangafhani vho ḓivhadzaho saiti.
honestLimitNoAv: Hezwi a si tshibveledzwa tsha antivirus. U vala thebu hu ima u ṅwala datha hafha; a i sikeini kana i kunise tshishumiswa tshavho.
feedbackFalsePositive: Folaga yo khakheaho — ṅwalwa lwa tshiga tsho khakheaho
feedbackEmpty: A hu athu vha na ṅwalwa dza mbuno.
feedbackDraftsAfterReport: Nga murahu ha ṅwalwa lwa u ḓivhadza Ima: swaiyani mutevhe fhasi, bvisani batches/*.json, nga murahu mushumi a shumise npm run threat:apply. A hu rumiwi tshithu u bva kha bhurauza iḽi.
desktopDownloadSetupGuide: Bulaṱho ya u vhea (a yo ngo sainiwa)
desktopHonestLimitsLink: Mielano ya vhulondololi ya app ya teseke
faqParentsIntro: What this tool does and does not — useful before trusting a Halt result.
faqNoWipeBody: buusdo does not delete system files and does not reset the device.
faqNoAvBody: No AV engine or signatures — structure signals, own list, and probes.
faqNoCrowdBody: URLs are not sent to Google Safe Browsing or other third-party services.
